Cookie notice

Last updated: 9 October 2026

We do not use analytics, advertising trackers or marketing cookies on this website.

What cookies do

Cookies are small pieces of information stored by your browser. Similar technologies include browser local storage. They can support essential functions or track how a website is used.

What this website uses

Our website code does not set cookies or store information in your browser's local or session storage. Navigation, package comparisons and scroll effects work without saving your preferences. Fonts and images are served with the website, rather than loaded from Google Fonts or an embedded social-media service.

The hosting and access service may use strictly necessary cookies to authenticate access, maintain security or prevent abuse. These are separate from AMK's page code and are not used by AMK for advertising or audience analytics.

External booking links

Our call buttons take you to Google Calendar. We do not embed its booking interface in this website. When you follow the link, Google's own cookies and privacy arrangements apply. See Google's cookie information and privacy policy.

Your choices

You can manage or delete cookies through your browser settings. Blocking essential cookies may prevent access to protected pages or external booking services. There is no optional-cookie consent banner because this site has no optional analytics or advertising technologies. If these are added, we will update this notice and provide any required consent controls before activating them.

Questions

Email contact@amkaccountancy.co.uk. Our privacy notice explains how personal information is handled.
